cc:Work.dc:title: communication-ch2-fourier
cc:Work.dc:description: Analytic Fourier examples: rectangular pulses 1 and 0.5 ms; equal peak amplitude; normalized magnitude spectra, an added phase -2 pi f td with td=0.5 ms, and cosine modulation of a triangular baseband spectrum with half-amplitude sidebands.
